summary.text: Vinnie Miresse is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 71 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Jeff Disher.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as construction professional.

paragraphs.text: Vinnie Miresse was born in Wisconsin and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Stevens Point in 2001.

His career experience includes working as a construction professional, and he has been affiliated with groups including the Midwest Renewable Energy Association, Wisconsin Farmers Union and the Portage County Business Council.
Miresse took office in the Assembly in January 2025, succeeding Katrina Shankland.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Environment, Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation, and Sporting Heritage.
